title: Problem details everywhere: one error shape on every failure path
asA: API consumer building error handling once
iWant: every error response, planned or unplanned, to carry the same RFC 7807 envelope
soThat: my client renders and reacts to any failure from structure, never from guessing at ad-hoc bodies

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every 4xx and 5xx response body is an RFC 7807 problem-details object carrying type, title, status, detail, and instance, served as application/problem+json.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any error response from any endpoint
acceptanceCriteria.when: the body and content type are inspected
acceptanceCriteria.then: the body carries the five base fields and the content type is application/problem+json

acceptanceCriteria.description: Service-specific extension fields on the envelope are declared in the generated spec; no error response carries undeclared extensions.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the generated spec's problem-details schema and observed error responses
acceptanceCriteria.when: extension fields are compared against the declaration

acceptanceCriteria.description: The status field inside the envelope always equals the HTTP status code of the response carrying it.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the body's status field and the HTTP status line are compared

acceptanceCriteria.description: 4xx responses carry actionable detail (what was wrong with the request and how to correct it); 5xx responses carry the instance id for support without leaking stack traces, queries, or internal paths.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the 4xx names the client-side correction; the 5xx exposes the correlation instance and no internals

acceptanceCriteria.description: Unhandled exceptions are converted to a 500 problem-details response by a final error middleware; no path returns a framework default error page or bare stack output.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a handler that throws an unexpected exception
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 500 with the declared envelope, not a framework default body

acceptanceCriteria.description: Errors raised before routing completes (unknown path, method not allowed, oversized body, unparseable JSON) also carry the envelope, proving it holds outside handler code.
acceptanceCriteria.given: requests triggering pre-routing failures: unknown path, wrong method, oversized body, malformed JSON
acceptanceCriteria.then: each carries the declared problem-details envelope with the appropriate 4xx status
